summary: Comprehensive full-app testing completed. 41/41 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend pages and features verified working. Fixed bug: 'chatbot' feature was missing from valid_features list in /api/users/{user_id}/features endpoint.

bug_fixes_applied.issue: The 'chatbot' feature was missing from the valid_features list in the PUT /api/users/{user_id}/features endpoint. This caused 400 errors when trying to update the chatbot feature via API.
bug_fixes_applied.fix: Added 'chatbot' to valid_features list and default features dict
